title: Brain Plastic Rose Nearly 50% In 8 Years
hook: Plastic in human brains rose nearly 50% in 8 years.
closing: Plastic exposure is no longer outside us, making its health effects impossible to ignore.
question: What plastic would you cut first?

segments.say: Brain plastic reached 4,900 micrograms per gram. The particles are accumulating inside tissue meant to protect thought.
Microplastics appeared in 100% of tested placentas. Exposure reaches people before birth.
Plaque containing microplastics carried 4.5 times the risk. The link is alarming even before causation is proven.
